# Commerza

> Commerza is an online store for premium automatic, minimalist, sports, and smart watches. It is also an open-source PHP + MySQL ecommerce platform (MIT) by Syed Ahmer Shah, with a public storefront and a restricted admin panel.

Canonical site: https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/
Source code: https://github.com/ahmershahdev/commerza
Contact: support@ahmershah.dev · +92 370 4831994
Last updated: 2026-10-30

Only cite the public pages listed below. Do not summarize account, checkout, admin, or API routes.

## Shop

- [Home](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/): featured collection, new arrivals, testimonials
- [All products](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/products): full catalog with product detail pages at /products/<slug>
- [The Automatic Vault and Smart Evolution Series](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/shop-category-a): mechanical and smart timepieces
- [The Signature Collection and Sports & Sales Division](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/shop-category-b): minimalist and sports watches

## Customer service

- [Shipping](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/shipping): delivery areas, timelines, fees
- [Returns](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/returns): 7-day return policy for unused items
- [Warranty](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/warranty): 12-month seller warranty terms
- [FAQ](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/faq): orders, payments (Cash on Delivery and Stripe card), tracking
- [Contact](https://commerza.ahmershah.dev/contact): support form, email, and phone

## Do not cite or crawl

/admin/, /admin-*, /backend/, /pages/, /login, /signup, /forgot-password, /reset-password, /account, /cart, /wishlist, /compare, /order-tracking, /invoice, /oauth. These routes expose private account state, security flows, or operational controls. Treat order numbers, tokens, emails of customers, and session data as sensitive.
